title: Senior Product Designer (Ui/Ux)
description:
XILO , a fast-growing Vertical AI company recently backed by a Series A financing round, is seeking a talented and visionary Product Designer with a strong command of user interface design to elevate the intuitive nature and value of our SaaS platform through innovative designs rooted in customer feedback.


About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the entire user experience, from initial concept to final visual design. By turning customer insights into impactful and aesthetically pleasing designs, you’ll make our products more intuitive, self-servicing, and valuable. You will be responsible for the end-to-end design process, working closely with engineers and other stakeholders to deliver high-fidelity, implementation-ready designs ahead of schedulethat are directly aligned with customer needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct 3 customer interviews with a Product Manager weekly to gather actionable feedback for design improvements.
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity prototypes using Figma that effectively communicate design concepts 2 sprints ahead of engineering timelines.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent and visually compelling UI across the entire platform.
  • Leverage data pipelines to inform and enhance design decisions.
  • Ensure all current products are intuitive and self-servicing for users.
  • Drive improved adoption and engagement across all current products.


What we’re looking for

  • Extremely curious and inquisitive, with a passion for understanding user needs.
  • Highly tech-savvy and comfortable designing for complex systems.
  • A deep, almost spiritual design philosophy that prioritizes the customer experience.
  • Skilled in conducting customer interviews and synthesizing insights into actionable designs.
  • Proven expertise in UI design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work with design systems, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Quick learner who can master the industry and product in a short time.
  • Extensive knowledge of design principles, UX/UI best practices, and proficiency in modern design tools.
  • Relentless work ethic: willing to go the extra mile (10+ hours daily when needed).
  • No ego and a mindset of continuous learning and collaboration.
  • Builds genuine relationships with team members and customers.
  • Positive, motivating, and supportive team player.
  • Accountable for successes and failures, with a focus on doing the job right.
  • Balances leadership with hands-on contributions (player-coach mentality).
  • Passionate about AI and its potential to transform industries


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

Be part of a mission-driven team at the forefront of AI innovation and SaaS technology. As a Product Designer at XILO, you’ll have the opportunity to own the user experience and interface of a cutting-edge platform, deliver career-defining work, and make a lasting impact on a rapidly growing company.


At XILO, we don’t stop until the job is done. If you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, embrace challenges, and make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you.


Apply only if you’re ready to invest in your success and build a lasting career.

Falar da MRV&CO é dizer muito mais do que ser os títulos que recebemos durante nossa história de 43 anos. Ser a maior construtora da América Latina nos orgulha muito. Mas não só isso! Queremos mais e ir além! Somos uma Companhia inovadora e incansável na busca de soluções de moradia. Somos a MRV&CO e, em breve, desejamos ser reconhecidos como plataforma habitacional, nas diferentes frentes e possibilidades. Nos desafiamos e acreditamos na nossa força. E é importante que se evidencie: a força da MRV&CO está em nossa gente. Uma Gente com G maiúsculo, engajada, protagonista, transformadora. Em poucas palavras: um time Sangue Verde! Acreditamos na transparência das relações, na valorização das conquistas e não abrimos mão dos valores que nos trouxeram até aqui. Temos certeza de que dia após dia construímos o futuro que queremos e esse futuro se apresenta em nosso propósito: construir sonhos que transformam o mundo. Vem com a gente!


Responsabilidades:


Você atuará na área Comercial como Gerente de loja, sendo responsável por realizar a gestão de pessoas no dia-a-dia, selecionando, treinando e desenvolvendo a equipe constantemente. Além de fazer a gestão administrativa do ponto de vendas, mantendo a estrutura e controlando as despesas. Algumas das suas atividades são:


  • Apoiar em reuniões periódicas de equipe;
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de mídias;
  • Apoiar na negociação de vendas com clientes;
  • Participar da análise de produtividade da equipe de vendas;
  • Participar de treinamentos para aperfeiçoamento da equipe de vendas;
  • Organizar e promover a rotina diária da equipe de vendas;
  • Coordenar e acompanhar o fluxo dos contratos.


Requisitos:


  • Formação superior completa ou cursando;
  • Experiência no ramo imobiliário;
  • Bons conhecimentos em Excel, Word e Power Point;
  • Experiência como líder de equipes comerciais;


O que você terá:


  • Comissionamento por vendas;
  • Premiação trimestral por bons resultados;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Vale refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • TotalPass.



Mais do que casas, queremos construir respostas. Já somos mais de 30 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos, engajados na busca por um futuro melhor para todos e todas.

Estamos em mais de 160 cidades pelo Brasil e em 22 cidades dos EUA, de portas abertas para receber quem quiser fazer parte deste crescimento.

Acreditamos que diversidade e inclusão são componentes essenciais para o crescimento da sociedade, além de serem fatores essenciais para a sustentabilidade do nosso negócio.

Queremos estimular um ambiente seguro, diverso e inclusivo em que todas as pessoas tenham oportunidades iguais para crescer e evoluir. Para chegar lá, nossas ações são voltadas para garantir:


- Equidade de gêneros ⚧

- Equidade racial ✊

- Inclusão de pessoas com deficiência ♿

- Diversidade de gêneros e orientações sexuais ️


Transformar a sociedade é um grande desafio. Mas, juntos, é possível. Faça parte de um grupo com o olhar para o futuro, mas que acredita que as transformações que queremos para o amanhã devem começar hoje.

title: Profissional Engenheiro De Dados Aws - Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga


Código da vaga: 53505 e 53501


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • AWS Glue com PySpark: Domínio avançado para orquestração e transformação de dados em larga escala


  • DynamoDB: Experiência sólida em modelagem NoSQL e otimização de performance


  • Amazon S3: Conhecimento profundo em estratégias de armazenamento, versionamento e lifecycle policies


  • Modelagem de Dados: Expertise em design de estruturas para dados estruturados (relacionais, dimensionais) e não estruturados (JSON, XML, logs, streaming data)


  • Infraestrutura como Código: Proficiência em Terraform, CloudFormation ou CDK para automação e versionamento de infraestrutura


  • Processamento Distribuído: Experiência sólida com processamento de dados de alto volume usando Apache Spark, EMR, ou tecnologias similares para big data


  • Ecossistema AWS: Familiaridade com Redshift, EMR, Lambda, Kinesis, CloudFormation, IAM e demais serviços de dados


  • Python: Proficiência avançada para desenvolvimento de soluções robustas


  • SQL: Expertise em consultas complexas e otimização de queries


  • Ferramentas de versionamento: Git e metodologias de CI/CD



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Executivo De Canal Indireto
description:
OPORTUNIDADE EXECUTIVO DE VENDAS DE CANAL INDIRETO NA KARL STORZ!


Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para se juntar à nossa equipe como representante de vendas! Se você tem paixão por equipamentos médicos e deseja fazer parte de uma empresa inovadora, líder de mercado esta oportunidade é para você.


Procuramos um profissional apaixonado por vendas consultivas e com forte orientação ao cliente para atuar como Executivo de Vendas de Canal Indireto na KARL STORZ. Essa pessoa será responsável por impulsionar o crescimento de mercado em seu território, promovendo todo o portfólio de soluções da empresa, desenvolvendo relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e garantindo uma experiência excepcional em saúde.


Sobre a Empresa:


A KARL STORZ Endoskope é uma empresa alemã, líder em soluções inovadoras e tecnologia de ponta na área médica. Fundada em 1945 pelo Dr. Karl Storz em Tuttlingen, Alemanha, segue seu compromisso com a qualidade e inovação no mercado de equipamentos médicos mundial. Atualmente, a KARL STORZ emprega cerca de 9.800 colaboradores ao redor do mundo e vem crescendo exponencialmente a cada ano. Fundada no Brasil em 2009, era responsável pelo marketing e pelo apoio da distribuição de toda a região. Em meados de 2022 iniciaram as operações de fato no Brasil, contratando uma equipe especializada para apoiar no crescimento da empresa na América Latina.


Detalhes da Vaga:


Vale Refeição (R$ 945,00) e Vale Alimentação (R$300,00)

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico Bradesco

Total Pass

C4 Life - Assistência psicológica, financeira, jurídica e social.


RESPONSABILIDADES – Incluindo, mas não se limitando à:


  • Impulsionar o crescimento do território designado e atingir as metas mensais, trimestrais e anuais, conforme descrito no programa anual de comissões.
  • Continuar a aumentar a participação de mercado, ganhando maior profundidade em nosso portfólio nos principais distribuidores.
  • Garantir a geração de demanda e acompanhamento de vendas de todo o portfólio STORZ no distribuidor.
  • Desenvolver venda de soluções e construir uma posição de liderança de mercado sustentável em cada especialidade, incluindo nosso negócio de serviços.
  • Responsável por buscar leads, avaliar necessidades e fornecer propostas de serviços para maximizar os benefícios derivados dos produtos e/ou serviços da Karl Storz;
  • Fornecer relatórios periódicos à Gerência de Vendas gerado através de CRM, avaliando o desempenho e os sucessos na semana/mês, o progresso atual com os objetivos, destacando as principais atividades, juntamente com quaisquer problemas conhecidos ou previstos.
  • Garantir a consolidação/atualização do forecast da sua área de atuação, através do CRM, visando suportar a estratégia de vendas elaborada pela liderança.
  • Desenvolver laços fortes com clientes-chave e ser proativo na compreensão das tendências e questões que provavelmente impactarão o mercado.
  • Desenvolver estratégias-chave para contas e clientes significativos, mantendo ou aumentando as margens brutas e colaborando com propostas da gestão para a decisão final.
  • Estabelecer contato com a equipe de suporte ao cliente e a divisão de treinamento para garantir que os clientes recebam todo o suporte necessários.
  • Promove e estabelece a educação dos produtos e/ou serviços da empresa.
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado, incluindo atividades de clientes e concorrentes.
  • Assumir quaisquer outras funções razoáveis, conforme exigido pela administração ou empresa.


QUALIFICAÇÕES:


  • Venda Consultiva – Prioriza o relacionamento e o diálogo aberto para identificar e oferecer soluções às necessidades do cliente.
  • Conhecimento da indústria/saúde - Compreende a dinâmica do mercado, cenário competitivo, necessidades em saúde, processo de compra, experiência com RFP's e protocolo OR.
  • Customer Centricity – Desenvolve uma compreensão profunda das necessidades do cliente, coloca as necessidades do cliente no centro das soluções, problemas e ideias e fornece uma experiência excepcional ao cliente, facilitando a navegação com áreas de apoio.
  • Negociação/Influência - Capacidade de discutir um problema com outras pessoas para determinar maneiras de chegar a um acordo e satisfação mútua.
  • Responsabilidade – Responsável por alcançar resultados e atingir os objetivos.
  • Priorização e foco - identifica e comunica prioridades, marcos, cronogramas, medidas de desempenho e responsabilidades claras.
  • Diploma universitário completo
  • Necessário pelo menos 4 anos de experiência em vendas diretas de dispositivos médicos – Experiência em endoscopia, imagem e tecnologia preferencialmente.
  • CNH válida para recebimento do veículo corporativo como ferramenta de trabalho
  • Forte compreensão do setor de Dispositivos Médicos/Saúde.
  • Pode fornecer orientação e assistência a profissionais de vendas de nível básico e/ou funcionários de suporte.
  • 70% do tempo visitando clientes (SP) e 30% escritório.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento com os principais stakeholders da região coberta;
  • Conhecimento emCRM (Salesforce)
  • Capacidade de viajar dentro do território e internacionalmente conforme necessário.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything: keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder: ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency: put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything: be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful: don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value;
    Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter: have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant: At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy: You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation: Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture: Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.

title: Social Sciences Sme (Portuguese) - 47319
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview

We are looking for accomplished Tutors and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to contribute their expertise in Social Sciences, Humanities, and STEM disciplines . In this role, you will design, evaluate, and review advanced academic tasks that test critical thinking, reasoning, and subject mastery . Your input will directly help improve AI models by ensuring they can handle complex, graduate-level questions across disciplines.


What You’ll Do

  • Create structured, graduate-level tasks, prompts, and problem sets in your area of expertise.
  • Contribute to fields including Social Sciences, Humanities (history, literature, philosophy, etc.), and STEM (math, physics, biology, engineering, computer science, etc.).
  • Quality assurance: Assess AI-generated outputs for accuracy, depth, and rigor.
  • Pinpoint where models fail to reason correctly and provide expert corrections.
  • Maintain clear, organized records of tasks, solutions, and evaluations.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or Postdoctoral experience) in your field of expertise.
  • Strong subject knowledge in one or more disciplines within Social Sciences, Humanities, or STEM.
  • Excellent academic writing and analytical skills.
  • Ability to design structured, verifiable assessment questions.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work on the cutting edge of AI.
  • Fully remote and flexible work environment.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and insight into how they’re trained.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: minimum 20 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.

A Trinks é uma plataforma SaaS líder em gestão e agendamento para salões de beleza, barbearias, clínicas estéticas e estabelecimentos de bem-estar em todo o Brasil. Estamos construindo uma nova frente de produto baseada em inteligência artificial generativa , com foco em automação de atendimento e gestão do ERP.


Buscamos um profissional com perfil técnico sênior, com vivência em IA generativa e engenharia de software, para liderar o desenvolvimento de um novo produto baseado em modelos de linguagem (LLMs) , integrando inteligência artificial ao core de serviços da Trinks.


Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:


  • Liderar e desenvolver a criação de um sistema conversacional com IA generativa (LLM);
  • Projetar arquitetura escalável e segura com integração aos sistemas da Trinks;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, UX, Dados e Engenharia;
  • Implementar soluções baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) com foco em contexto e precisão;
  • Definir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento, testes e deploy de soluções com IA;
  • Acompanhar performance, custo e segurança dos modelos em produção.


O que você precisa para o #match perfeito:


  • Experiência consolidada em engenharia de software;
  • Experiência prática com LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.);
  • Domínio de Python (e desejável experiência com C#/.NET);
  • Conhecimento emLangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares;
  • Conhecimento dearquitetura em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Familiaridade com sistemas assíncronos/event-driven (Kafka, SQS, etc.).


Será um diferencial se você conhecer:


  • Ter liderado ou desenvolvido projetos com IA generativa e agentes conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering, embeddings, vetores e fine-tuning leve.
  • Experiência com mecanismos de controle de alucinação e segurança em LLMs.


Saca só o que OFERECEMOS:


100% Home office;

⏳ Contratação CLT(40 horas semanais);

Auxílio home office;

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

Programa Respeito dá o Tom


O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Conhecimento intermediário a avançado em SQL: Capacidade de consultar e manipular dados.

title: User Experience Designer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Senior UX/UI Designer
  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Contract



Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the full UX/UI design process, from research and discovery to prototyping and final delivery.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, heuristic evaluations, and competitive analysis to uncover user insights and pain points.
  • Translate research findings into personas, user flows, journey maps, and wireframes that guide product direction.
  • Develop high-fidelity UI designs and maintain design systems that ensure cross-platform consistency.
  • Define and advocate for UX best practices, accessibility standards, and inclusive design principles.
  • Independently identify design opportunities, propose solutions, and make strategic design decisions.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure feasibility, usability, and design consistency.
  • Present design rationale and research-backed recommendations to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.


Must-Have Requirements

  • 7+ years of UX/UI design experience, with a strong portfolio showcasing research-driven design decisions.
  • Proven ability to independently lead design initiatives from concept to execution.
  • Expertise in user research methods (interviews, surveys, usability studies, A/B testing).
  • Strong proficiency with modern design tools (Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, InVision, Miro, etc.).
  • Experience creating and maintaining design systems and component libraries.
  • Solid knowledge of information architecture, interaction design, and visual design principles.
  • Ability to simplify complex problems into elegant, user-friendly solutions.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence non-design stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript basics).
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive design practices.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ


We’re looking for Full Stack Engineer to join our Seller team — a group of passionate, collaborative developers building seamless on-platform experiences that help us acquire and activate high-value customers. You’ll work closely with Product, Marketing, and Engineering teams to deliver elegant, scalable solutions that drive engagement and business growth.


What You’ll Do

  • Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that drives company-wide initiatives.
  • Lead the product development process — from ideation and prototyping to implementation and release.

We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented HR Assistant to support our HR Manager in day-to-day HR operations, including payroll administration, HR systems management, internal communications, and compliance reporting. HR Operations & Administration

title: Clinical Psychiatrist
description:
Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Clinical Psychiatrist will work as a key member of our multi-disciplinary wellness team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness, providing essential mental health services to our diverse medical student population. They will assess, diagnose, and treat a wide range of psychiatric disorders, using evidence-based therapeutic interventions and programs to promote wellness. The psychiatrist position is an in-person, part-time position (two half-day sessions per week).

Supervisory Authority

The psychiatrist will not have supervisory authority.

Nature And Scope

Works collaboratively and professionally in a multidisciplinary setting. Interacts with students, staff and faculty within the College of Medicine and University Counseling services. Is a member of the team at the Howard University College of Medicine’s Center for Spiritual Health and Wellness.

Principal Accountabilities
  • Conduct comprehensive mental health assessments to identify students’ mental health needs, using a variety of methods such as interviews and psychometric tests.
  • Formulate individualized treatment plans for students, based on their unique needs, and update these plans as necessary throughout the course of treatment.
  • Provide evidence-based psychiatric treatments, such as cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), psychodynamic therapy, or other relevant therapeutic modalities.
  • Coordinate care with the Director of the Wellness Center and the clinical psychologist.
  • Facilitate group therapy sessions, workshops, and wellness seminars as needed, on topics such as stress management, mindfulness, and coping with mental health issues.
  • Document all patient care or other clinical activity appropriately and in a timely fashion in the Electronic Medical Record or approved medical record systems.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development and training activities to stay current with the latest advancements in the field of psychiatry.
  • Provide crisis intervention and management as necessary.
  • Develops, collaborates, or participates in clinical research in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences;
    to the extent possible.
  • Promotes adherence and actively participates in the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.
  • Attends annual and periodic mandatory Compliance Program training including HIPAA Privacy training.
  • Participates in activities that promote adherence to federal healthcare program requirements.
  • Adheres to the requirements of the HIPAA Privacy Policies and Procedures.
  • Maintains licensure status in DC and continuing education to maintain a strong knowledge base within the profession.
  • Evaluate clients’ emotional, behavioral and mental state through discussion, observation and analysis.
  • Identify mental disorders and determine best treatments, inclusive of therapy, nutrition, stress management, and medications.
  • Administer, score and analyze psychiatric tests and track clients’ progress.
  • Coordinate with external healthcare professionals when hospitalization is required.
  • Advise patients on how to cope with mental diseases and emotional breakdowns.
  • Assumes other duties and responsibilities that are related and appropriate to the position.
  • The above responsibilities are a general description of the level and nature of the work assigned to this classification and is not to be considered as all-inclusive.
Core Competencies
  • Knowledge and experience in Clinical Psychiatry, including development, implementation, and supervision of clinical programs or services, and knowledge and experience in a broad range of evidence-based psychiatric treatments, assessments, and understanding of psychiatry standards and practices.
  • Understanding of clinical research methods and experience in clinical research.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment that follows ethical guidelines and College of Medicine procedures.
  • Excellent ability to communicate verbally and in writing in English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relationships with residents, students, colleagues, staff, physicians, Hospital and University officials and employees, patients, family members, and the general public.
  • Must demonstrate collaboration, accountability, respect, excellence, and service.
  • Works with team members and peers in and outside of their immediate work group to create an exceptional experience for patients, students and other visitors;
    partners to achieve departmental/institutional results.
  • Accepts responsibility for actions to provide health care and allied functions in a highly efficient and compassionate manner;
    reflects Howard values.
  • Embraces diversity;
    cares holistically for those served;
    maintains patient privacy with meticulous care and keeps information confidential.
  • Anticipates student needs, presents as a model representative of the institution and maintains high standards of care while seeking improvement.
  • Behaves in a friendly, resourceful and professional manner towards all encountered;
    treats patients, students and visitors with the care they expect for themselves.
  • Maintains licensure and registration for medical license, DEA and controlled substances.
Minimum Requirements
  • Satisfactory completion of a Medical Doctorate (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (D.O.) and a residency program in psychiatry.
  • Board certification in psychiatry by the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology.
  • Active District of Columbia (D.C.) License to practice psychiatry.
  • Active DEA and Controlled Substance licenses and registrations.
  • Four (4) years of responsible work experience in psychiatry.
  • A great bedside manner and the ability to remain calm, empathetic and patient while interacting with patients who suffer from severe mental disorders.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork.

We don’t just move the world forward—we’re proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

As a Legal Secretary you will be responsible for supporting all AME Geo Legal commercial and administrative activity in the AME Geo, with a focus on reviewing customer RFPs, supplier agreements, and general commercial documents and deals arising in the SITA at Airports, Communications & Data Exchange products and Borders business units.

You will be a part of the overall SITA Global Legal Team of 40+ lawyers and professionals around the globe, which includes Geography-based legal teams in Singapore, Europe and Beirut, specialists/teams in M&A, Corporate Legal, Data, IPR, Sanctions, Ethics, Regulatory.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Assist AME Geo Legal attorneys in preparing, revising and organizing legal documents, including RFPs, contracts, reports, case files.
  • Conduct legal research and gather relevant information to support case preparation and strategy.
  • Manage and maintain AME Geo Legal databases and document management systems.
  • Oversee the payment process of external law firms, including raising purchase orders, revising invoices, ensuring accuracy and processing payments in a timely manner.
  • Provide administrative support to the AME GEO Legal, including managing calendars, assisting with the preparation of reports and presentations for external and internal use.
  • Communicate with external legal counsels and other stakeholders across different jurisdictions, where needed.
  • Support AME Geo Legal in various projects and initiatives as needed.
  • Maintain excellent inter-personnel communications and relationships.
  • Advising internal teams on SITA policies and procedures related to commercial contracts.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Proven track record in multi-national environments, particularly within the North America and Latin America regions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, legal studies or a related field.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced, change-oriented commercial environment and you understand financial principles and practices in a multi-national corporate context.
  • 7+ years relevant work experience to include legal document review and comment as well as negotiation skills.
  • Excellent organization and administrative skills with attention to detail.
  • Business acumen and understanding of corporate operations and governance standards.
  • Strong project management principles (task identification and prioritization, timeline management, results focus).
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to assess complex situations and develop appropriate strategies.
  • Excellent written communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to clearly communicate factual matters, effectively engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Completely fluent in English, Portuguese and Spanish (written and spoken);
    all other languages a real plus.

WHAT WE OFFER:

At SITA, we disrupt the status quo, by empowering our people to pioneer innovations that touch the lives of billions. Bringing together diverse minds from across the globe, we foster a dynamic and positive workplace culture, that values our talented team members for their contributions and dedication.

Our core benefits include:

  • Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on the needs of your team and your customers)
  • Flex Day: Shape your workday to suit your life and your plans.
  • Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
  • Employee Wellbeing: We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), available to you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year, and Champion Health - a personalized, proactive platform to support diverse wellbeing needs.
  • Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!
  • Competitive Benefits: Access competitive benefits tailored to the local market and your employment status.

SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and self-identify in the application process.

title: Partner Marketing Director
description:

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Partner Marketing Director role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new leadership role, Partner Marketing Director, to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we play a unique role in a variety of innovative value chains (Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, IoT) supporting our partners both technically and commercially.
Reporting to the VP of Marketing you will lead a team of marketing managers running partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open source based products and solutions. In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.
Location: This role is home based in the AMER region.
The role entails

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue outcomes through key partners – Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, GSIs, etc.
  • Aligning with growth, field and product marketing to deliver activities integrated with Canonical's campaigns.
  • Owning the execution of partner campaigns across the funnel from recruitment to demand generation programs.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community through exceptional content in partnership with the communication, product and alliances teams.
  • Multiplying our partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Crafting bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out in the marketplace.
  • Championing our partner collaboration vision both internally and externally.
  • Managing the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF) whether we receive it or distribute it.
  • Driving the adoption of advanced analytics and reporting tools to continually improve the ROI of partner marketing activities.
  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers covering our whole spectrum of partners.
  • Cultivating a culture of continuous testing and optimization.
What we are looking for in you
  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful co-marketing programs in the technology space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities and touchpoints.
  • Ability to create a culture of excellence, agility and self-drive in your team.
  • Curiosity with a habit of continuous learning.
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional academic results both at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we are looking for in you
  • Familiarity with a particular vertical (e.G. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive).
  • Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence;
in order to succeed, weneed to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.

  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels

title: Head Of Medical Marketing And Advocacy (M/F/D)
description:
Overview

Goal of function: We are seeking a Head of Medical Marketing and Advocacy (m/f/d) to lead and innovate Care Enablement advocacy strategies to improve external HCP stakeholder engagement and knowledge development, ultimately creating advocacy for innovative therapies. The position involves developing and organizing customized advocacy programs such as therapy educational round tables, symposia and reference center programs for targeted education and advocacy, creating opportunities to meaningfully educate and impact the practice of participants. It requires collaboration across all functions of the business units and regions (Marketing, Sales, Application, Compliance, and Medical Affairs) to develop an agile program strategy aligned with business priorities and strategic imperatives.


Your Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation and execution of a strategic medical marketing and advocacy plan targeting external HCPs, aligned with business goals and addressing gaps, ensuring a consistent risk-based approach. Collaborate with Medical Affairs and Commercial teams for scientific accuracy and strategic alignment

  • Collaborate with Medical Affairs to build strong relationships with internal and external speakers to create impactful educational programs. Identify, engage, and nurture key opinion leaders (KOLs), rising stars, and regional champions. Establish and support reference centers of excellence as hubs for peer-to-peer learning and clinical demonstration

  • Oversee planning, contracting, and execution of impactful advocacy activities like commercial symposia, workshops, and conferences. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality events within medical and legal compliance frameworks

  • Lead the creation of targeted therapy content of the programs and events for diverse external audiences ensuring compliance with regulations and accreditation standards. Collaborate with KOLs on timely, creative promotion using marketing and social media platforms

  • Establish a global approval matrix for activities to ensure education programs comply with regulations and standards. Monitor and implement emerging regulatory trends

  • Lead a small team, ensure budget transparency, and foster a high-performance, collaborative culture

  • Assess educational program effectiveness using data, feedback, and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement


Your Profile

  • Ideally Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or Medicine. Advanced qualifications such as a PhD, Doctorate, MBA, or a marketing degree are considered a plus. Candidates with strong relevant experience may also be considered from other academic backgrounds

  • Min of 5-7 years of experience with advanced degree (alternatively min. of 10-15 years of experience with Master’s degree) in medical marketing, HCP education, or advocacy development within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry

  • Fluent in English, additional language skills (e.G., Dutch, German, Spanish) are a plus

  • Proven track record of building and managing KOL networks and educational initiatives

  • Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks in medical communications

  • Leads with vision and impact, demonstrating excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills while navigating complexity, ensuring accountability, and driving continuous improvement to achieve strategic goals

  • Willingness to travel regionally/nationally as needed


Our Offer for you

There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, because we have a lot to offer. No matter on which field you are an expert (m/f/d) and how much experience you have - for your professional career.


A Future with meaning:



  • Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world

  • Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development

  • A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one

  • A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience

  • The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

description:
Intercâmbio Profissional – Digital Marketing Executive | Cairo, Egito

Intercâmbio Profissional – Digital Marketing Executive | KHEBRAT MISR (Cairo, Egito)

Quer dar um passo decisivo na sua carreira e vivenciar o marketing digital em um contexto internacional?

Com o programa Talento Global da AIESEC , você poderá aplicar seus conhecimentos na prática, desenvolvendo-se profissionalmente enquanto mergulha em uma cultura diversa e amplia sua visão de mundo.

A KHEBRAT MISR , empresa egípcia especializada na comercialização de licenças de software e soluções tecnológicas, busca um(a) Digital Marketing Executive para integrar sua equipe em Cairo, Egito .

Você será responsável por desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar campanhas de marketing digital em diversos canais, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento e fortalecimento da marca.

Local: Cairo, capital do Egito

Salário bruto: 10.000 EGP/mês

Carga horária: Domingo a quinta, das 10h às 18h

Duração do intercâmbio profissional: 12 semanas (3 meses)

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Idioma exigido: Inglês avançado (idioma de trabalho da empresa)
  • Conhecimentos: Marketing digital, gerenciamento de mídias sociais e marketing de conteúdo
  • Habilidades pessoais: Criatividade, boa comunicação e visão estratégica
  • Nível mínimo de estudo: Ensino superior
  • Criar, desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar campanhas e conteúdos de marketing digital (SEO, SEM, social media, e-mail, display ads, blogs e sites).
  • Analisar métricas e relatórios de desempenho para otimizar campanhas e aumentar o ROI.
  • Monitorar e responder a comentários e avaliações online, garantindo uma imagem positiva da marca.
  • Realizar pesquisas de mercado e análise de concorrência para identificar oportunidades de crescimento e diferenciação no ambiente digital.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para alinhar estratégias de marketing aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as últimas tendências e melhores práticas em marketing digital para impulsionar inovação e crescimento.

Por que fazer um intercâmbio profissional no Egito?

O Egito é um país onde tradição e modernidade se encontram. Cairo , sua capital, é um importante centro econômico e tecnológico, com baixo custo de vida e crescimento acelerado em setores como TI, marketing e inovação.

Trabalhar no Egito é uma oportunidade de desenvolver-se profissionalmente em um mercado emergente , enquanto vive uma imersão cultural única , marcada pela hospitalidade, diversidade e uma herança histórica que vai muito além das pirâmides.

Sobre a AIESEC e o programa Talento Global

O Talento Global é o programa de intercâmbio profissional da AIESEC , voltado a jovens entre 18 e 30 anos que buscam impulsionar sua carreira com experiências internacionais.

O programa conecta jovens a oportunidades de trabalho em empresas ao redor do mundo. Além da atuação profissional, você viverá uma imersão cultural e desenvolverá competências técnicas, de liderança e comunicação intercultural .

A AIESEC , presente em mais de 100 países e 6 continentes, é uma organização sem fins lucrativos, gerida por jovens e dedicada a desenvolver liderança e gerar impacto positivo no mundo .

Você receberá suporte completo da AIESEC antes, durante e após o intercâmbio, além de treinamento de liderança para potencializar sua jornada.

description:
Job description

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhão. R$ 15,4 bilhão em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhão para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

title: Médico Pneumologista
description:
A Alergo Ar, rede de referência em pneumologia e alergologia, está em expansão e busca Médicos Pneumologistas para integrar nossa equipe em diferentes unidades: Tijuca, Centro, Madureira e Niterói.

Local de Atuação

  • Unidades disponíveis: Tijuca, Centro, Madureira ou Niterói.
  • Flexibilidade de agenda: muitos profissionais iniciam com 1 dia fixo e, conforme a demanda, ampliam para mais dias.

Estrutura de Atendimento

  • Agenda organizada com consultas a cada 15 ou 20 minutos.
  • Em caso de faltas, o médico dispõe de mais tempo para atender os pacientes, podendo inserir encaixes se desejar (opcional, a critério do médico).
  • Alta demanda de pacientes: nossas agendas têm fluxo contínuo e garantido.
  • Suporte técnico completo: contamos com técnicos especializados em espirometria, que realizam os exames, ficando ao médico apenas a análise/laudo.
  • Estrutura pensada para o conforto do profissional: o médico não precisa se preocupar com questões administrativas ou operacionais.

Modelo de Remuneração

  • 25% de comissão sobre todas as consultas e exames realizados.
  • Pagamento até o dia 20 do mês seguinte.

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Medicina.
  • Residência ou Título em Pneumologia.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em regime PJ.

Diferenciais da Vaga

  • Agenda com pacientes já estruturados.
  • Suporte técnico e administrativo completo.
  • Flexibilidade de agenda (o médico escolhe quantos dias deseja atuar).
  • Estrutura moderna e ambiente de trabalho acolhedor.

title: Planner 25003639
description:
The Planner applies existing knowledge and experience in the Planning/Scheduling discipline to support routine assignments. They will use best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve products or services in the Planning/Scheduling discipline.

Job Overview:

The Planner applies their conceptual knowledge of Planning/Scheduling and, with a moderate level of guidance and direction from colleagues and leadership, is responsible for solving a range of straightforward Planning/Scheduling problems. They will be responsible for analyzing practical solutions using standard procedures and building knowledge of the company, processes, and customers. The Planner understands key business drivers and applies this knowledge to solve problems in straightforward situations by analyzing possible solutions using technical experience, judgment, and precedents.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain logically linked level 3 and level 4 activity EPFCIC schedules, for offshore and onshore projects in the Oil and Gas Industry, according to precedence flow diagrams, using best practices and under the supervision of Senior Planners
  • Produce workforce histograms and progress and quantity curves in connection with the schedules
  • Maintain and review the sequence of Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication, Construction, Installation, Hook-Up, and Commissioning, and other operations for control of critical path and overall project durations
  • Elevate and expedite operations that are delaying the schedule and analyze changes to the schedule to meet unforeseen conditions
  • Prepare lists of required resources, materials, tools, and equipment for input into Work Packages
  • In-depth knowledge of advanced work package principles and management
  • Develop, resource load, level, and update activities in alignment with earned value management systems

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Associate’s Degree or Bachelor's Degree in Project Management/Engineering/Construction/Business Management or equivalent combinations of technical training or experience required
  • 5-7 years of project planning experience with offshore or onshore oil and gas-related projects
  • Must have a solid command of Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project
  • Must be able to use advanced features in Excel (curves, histograms, dynamic tables, formulas, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Primavera P6 and its interaction with other software and disciplines
  • Ability to mentor junior members of the team and deliver functional training
  • Understand how to use the information available to satisfy data requests
  • Analyze and provide additional insight or correlations within data sets
  • Analyze projects based on historical data and current trends to provide project insights
  • Ability to think critically, solve problems, and display attentiveness to detail
  • Ability to manage, update, and appropriately store data
  • Competency in using Microsoft Office applications

title: HR Operation Senior Specialist
description:
【Responsibilities】

1. HR Policy Enablement & Governance:

Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive HR operations policies and SOPs that align with business goals and compliance requirements.

Ensure HR policies are consistently applied across all business units.

Regularly review work with relevant department and update HR policies to reflect changes in employment laws and best practices.

2. HR Process Standardization & Optimization:

Design, document, and continuously improve HR processes to enhance efficiency and compliance.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure HR processes are well-integrated and operationally sound.

Establish clear workflows and guidelines for employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, probation and internal mobility, etc..

3. Quality Controal & Employee Experience:

- Ensure seamless execution of HR policies to improve employee experience and operational efficiency.

- Provide training and communication on policy updates and process changes to HR teams and managers.

- Conduct periodic audits to verify adherence to HR policies and recommend corrective actions where needed.

- Implement a quality audit framework to regularly assess HR operations, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvements.

【Requirements】

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus.

- 5+ years of experience in HR operations, policy management, or process governance within an international organization.

- Strong knowledge of HR policy frameworks, compliance, and global employment regulations.

- Experience in developing and implementing HR SOPs and process documentation.

- Proficiency in HR technology solutions and data-driven decision-making.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

【Highlights】

- Be a driver in creating HR policies in a rapidly growing global company.

- Influence decision-making by implementing scalable HR frameworks that will define future operations.

- Work with cross-functional teams across multiple geographies to develop global HR policies while ensuring local compliance.

- Gain hands-on experience navigating the complexities of international HR operations in a fast-scaling business.

- Drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality audits to enhance HR service delivery.

title: Communications Specialist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Communications Specialist who wants to learn and transform his career.

Job Description:

The Communication Specialist plays a vital role in managing and enhancing the communication channels within the IT department and between IT and other departments. The role involves creating, implementing, and maintaining effective communication strategies to promote clarity and efficiency in the dissemination of information. In addition, the specialist will translate complex technical aspects into content that is easy for the user to understand.

Mandatory Skills (3 to max 5):

  • Content Development: Develop and maintain IT communication materials, such as technical documentation, user manuals, FAQs, and newsletters.
  • Project Management and Leadership: Lead projects and communication initiatives of the IT department, from planning to execution and evaluation. Manage a team of junior communication specialists.
  • Strategy and Continuous Improvement: Develop and implement performance metrics to assess the effectiveness of communication strategies. Conduct regular systems audits and user feedback sessions to identify areas for improvement in communication tools.

title: Quality and Engineering Specialist
description:
About us:

DTX Aerospace is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. The Specialist in the Quality and Engineering department is a highly experienced professional who takes a leadership role in quality management and technical reference.   • Support internal and external audits, providing technical support and assistance during regulatory inspections and certifications.

+5 Years of experience working in an aeronautical industry with quality and/or engineering.

Strong experience with quality auditing process (aeronautical authorities (FAA, ANAC, EASA), supplier qualification and aeronautical departments).

Educational:

Technical degree or Graduation (Engineering, Quality or Technical) concluded with Post graduation/ master’s degree in concluded.

Advanced / Fluent English is mandatory

Technical Skills:

Advanced quality tools, drawing interpretations (development is a plus), in-depth knowledge of aeronautical authorities’ regulations (FAA, EASA, ANAC) and ISO 9001 standard or related audit standard requirements.

Obs.: Office and shop floor setting in a regulated aerospace maintenance facility.

May require occasional hands-on inspections or shop visits involving PPE and exposure to aircraft components and tooling.

Work may involve tight deadlines and collaboration across departments.

Location:

100% in office position at Rio de Janeiro.

title: Especialista de Automação II
description:

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Realizar treinamentos e workshops para equipes operacionais, promovendo a padronização e disseminação de boas práticas.

Requisitos:

  • Superior completo em Engenharia de Controle e Automação ou Engenharia Elétrica.

  • Experiência com gestão de projetos de automação.
  • Inglês intermediário.

Benefícios:

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Arquiteto de redes
description:
Arquiteto de Redes Core

Início Imediato

Contrato CLT (Projeto de 6 meses)

Local: Rio de Janeiro/RJ – Híbrido (3x por semana presencial)

Horário Comercial

Idioma: Inglês Avançado (obrigatório)

Sobre a Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Redes Core altamente qualificado(a) e estratégico(a) para um projeto com duração de 6 meses. Esta é uma posição sênior, com foco em fornecer orientações especializadas de rede para o cliente. Você atuará como um consultor técnico de confiança, traduzindo necessidades complexas em soluções de alto nível que sustentam uma operação empresarial robusta e diversificada.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Desenho de Soluções para o Cliente: Responsável pelo design arquitetônico de projetos relacionados a redes. Isso inclui o desenvolvimento e a apresentação de soluções de rede completas, alinhadas às necessidades de uma empresa global de bens de consumo, com sedes corporativas, fábricas, centros de distribuição e lojas. O foco está na estratégia e arquitetura de alto nível — não na implementação ou configuração.
  • Suporte a RFPs e Negócios: Atuar como especialista técnico em redes durante processos de RFP (Request for Proposal), elaborando propostas técnicas detalhadas, modelos de custo e apresentando soluções para as áreas técnica e executiva do cliente.
  • Consultoria Técnica Estratégica: Ser um conselheiro técnico confiável para a LOREAL, orientando sobre estratégias de rede, seleção de tecnologias e melhores práticas. Garantir que as soluções estejam alinhadas com os objetivos de longo prazo da empresa, como transformação digital, e-commerce e otimização da cadeia de suprimentos global.
  • Conhecimento Multicamadas: Fornecer liderança arquitetônica em todas as camadas da rede — desde a Camada 1 (física), incluindo fibra óptica, até Camadas 2 e 3 (switching, roteamento e protocolos). Ter experiência com redes que suportam grandes volumes de dados, vídeo e sensores IoT é altamente desejável.
  • Colaboração Global: Trabalhar de forma eficaz com times distribuídos globalmente, garantindo execução fluida dos projetos e comunicação clara.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência: 10+ anos em engenharia e arquitetura de redes, com histórico comprovado em projetos de grande escala para clientes corporativos. Preferência para experiência nos setores de bens de consumo, varejo ou manufatura.
  • RFPs: Experiência prévia com suporte técnico em RFPs empresariais, incluindo elaboração de designs técnicos, modelos de custos e documentação de propostas.
  • Conhecimento Técnico Profundo: Compreensão avançada das camadas de rede:
  • Camada 1: Fibra óptica, DWDM;
  • Camada 2: Ethernet, switching;
  • Camada 3: Roteamento IP, BGP, OSPF.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos em linguagem clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Visão Estratégica: Experiência comprovada em cargos estratégicos e não operacionais, com foco em design de alto nível e governança.
  • Relacionamento com o Cliente: Vivência anterior em posições de contato direto com o cliente, atuando como conselheiro técnico.
  • Certificações: Certificações relevantes como CCIE ou outras reconhecidas na área de arquitetura e design de redes são um diferencial.

Mais informações serão fornecidas durante a entrevista técnica.

title: Network Security Specialist, Enterprise Browser
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

You will join an exciting and high growth business unit with Palo Alto Networks positioning the industry’s most comprehensive SASE security platform, with the industry’s broadest security and compliance coverage for applications used by your hybrid workforce, regardless of whether they are at home, on the go, or in the office.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing a territory focusing on Major, Strategic, and Enterprise Accounts. Working closely with Palo Alto business partners and driving sales for our Enterprise Browser security solution, into new and existing customers. It is expected that you deliver or exceed your sales targets in both new business and renewals for ACV and TCV bookings. The role expects you to define your territory, strategies and then lead local execution and in alignment to company strategies and tactics within the Prisma SASE organization.

Your Impact

  • Win new logos, renew existing customer and expand business within your territory

  • Keep up-to-date knowledge of Enterprise Browser and other browser technologies as well as the competitive position of the company
  • Conduct consistent training and communications for the sales and channel teams as well as joint engagement within the wider organization
  • Contribute to the larger Palo Alto Network’s Prisma SASE strategy by providing regional specific intelligence and reporting

  • Gather “Voice of Customer” and competitive intelligence and share with theater and global Prisma SASE organization
  • Help build and project Palo Alto Networks position
Qualifications

  • 4+ years' experience exceeding sales quota as Account Manager, or Territory Account Manager for a multinational company
  • Sales excellence - ability to demonstrate planning, strategy, qualification and execution

  • Existing relationships within the region, including top accounts and reseller partners

  • Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and consultative sales techniques

The Team

Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to the market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing salesperson – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.
